summary.name: Xnip
summary.one_liner: Xnip is a lightweight Mac screenshot app offering scrolling capture, window capture, instant annotation, on-device text recognition (OCR), and always-on-top pinned images.
use_cases: Capture an entire long webpage in one image
Annotate a screenshot right after capturing it
Extract text from anything on screen
Keep a reference image floating above other windows
summary.what_it_does: Xnip is a screenshot and annotation app for macOS, triggered by a single keyboard shortcut. Its scrolling capture records webpages, long conversations, documents, and code that extend beyond the screen as one image. Window capture grabs a window with its native macOS shadow, and holding Shift selects several windows to capture together. Annotation tools are available immediately after capture, and the capture area can be resized while editing. The app also performs on-device text recognition (OCR) on screen content and can pin images as always-on-top floating windows.
notable: Scrolling capture for content larger than the screen
Shift-click to capture multiple windows at once
Listed on the Mac App Store for about 10 years
caveats: Mac only; no Windows or Linux version mentioned
Pricing is not stated on the page; the awesome-mac listing marks it as Freeware, but that is a third-party label
